pages.text:
Burns coal, charcoal and coal blocks into heat: 80 HU/t, up to 1,100°C. The heat leaves through its heat face into touching machines or Thermodynamic Conduits.
Heat upgrades get more heat from each fuel.
Feed it oxygen for oxy-fuel: see Oxy-Fuel.
Charcoal leaves Wood Ash in the ash slot half the time: take it out by hand or through an Output face.
Set a face to Flue Gas and it gives off Carbon Dioxide through it while it burns carbon fuels: see Carbon Capture.
